claim: If every message body is unique, you can enable content-based deduplication on an SNS FIFO topic and the subscribed SQS FIFO queues. SNS then hashes the message body to make the deduplication ID, so you don't need to set one. If a message is published with its own deduplication ID, the published ID overrides the generated one.

values.display: hash value to use as the deduplication ID

evidence.quote: If the message body is guaranteed to be unique for each published message, you can enable content-based deduplication for an Amazon SNS FIFO topic and the subscribed Amazon SQS FIFO queues. Amazon SNS uses the message body to generate a unique hash value to use as the deduplication ID for each message, so you don't need to set a deduplication ID when you send each message.

When content-based deduplication is enabled for an Amazon SNS FIFO topic, and a message is published with a deduplication ID, the published deduplication ID overrides the generated content-based deduplication ID.
